title: Reckoner button (v2)
description: Square, flat buttons in medium 14px type that change colour over a slow half-second ease: a sand button that turns merlot, and three for dark surfaces (a hairline outline and a faint tint that both fill with linen, and a solid linen one that turns sand).
notes: outline, tint and light are meant for the primary (merlot) surface
renders an <a> when given href, otherwise a <button>
